full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 66
Federal Parliament of Nepal
Daily Agenda
Wednesday, Ashoj 14, 2083
1:00 PM
Management Work
1. Honorable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs Sobita Gautam will present the following proposals:
(a) "To send the Mediation (Second Amendment) Bill, 2083 for clause-by-clause discussion to the relevant committee."
(b) "To send the Nepal Law Commission (First Amendment) Bill, 2083 for clause-by-clause discussion to the relevant committee."
(c) "To send the Free Legal Aid Related Bill, 2083 for clause-by-clause discussion to the relevant committee."
2. Honorable Minister for Agriculture, Forest and Environment Gita Chaudhary will present the proposal: "To send the Infectious Animal Disease (Control) Bill, 2083, originating in the National Assembly, for clause-by-clause discussion to the relevant committee."
3. Honorable Minister for Science, Technology and Innovation Mahabir Pun will:
(a) Present the proposal: "To discuss the National Forensic Science Laboratory (Establishment and Operation) Bill, 2082, along with the report of the Education, Health and Information Technology Committee, originating in the National Assembly."
(b) Present the proposal: "To pass the National Forensic Science Laboratory (Establishment and Operation) Bill, 2083, originating in the National Assembly."
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General

sections.summary_en: The Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs proposed sending three bills related to mediation, the Nepal Law Commission, and free legal aid to committees for clause-by-clause discussion. The Minister for Agriculture, Forest and Environment proposed sending the Infectious Animal Disease (Control) Bill to a committee. The Minister for Science, Technology and Innovation proposed discussing and passing the National Forensic Science Laboratory Bill.
